configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server shown in the server browser. Avoid quotes

configurationFields.label: Welcome Message
configurationFields.description: Optional chat message each player sees on joining. {name} is the player and {server} the server name. Avoid quotes

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time. Servers older than Project Reclaimer 0.9.6 support at most 63

configurationFields.label: Join Password
configurationFields.description: If set, players must enter this password to join. Leave blank to let anyone join. Avoid quotes

configurationFields.label: Hidden Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server is not listed in the server browser and players join it by address

configurationFields.label: Public Address
configurationFields.description: The address players connect to, such as a DNS name. Leave blank to detect this machine's public IPv4 address

configurationFields.label: Map
configurationFields.description: The map every game is played on. The map's files must be in the game folder (see the setup guide). Ignored if Use Custom Map or a Playlist File is set

configurationFields.label: Game Type
configurationFields.description: The game type for every game. Flood Infection and UNSC vs Covenant also need the campaign files. Ignored if a Custom Game Type or Playlist File is set

configurationFields.label: Use Custom Map
configurationFields.description: If enabled, every game is played on the Custom Map Name below instead of the Map above. Ignored if a Playlist File is set, or if the Custom Map Name is empty

configurationFields.label: Custom Map Name
configurationFields.description: The map to play when Use Custom Map is on, by file name without .map, such as hugeass_remastered_mcc. It must be in content/Mods or content/Maps. Avoid quotes

configurationFields.label: Custom Game Type
configurationFields.description: Optional. A custom game type in halo3-project-reclaimer/content/Game Modes (File Manager), by name or file, such as Momentum. Replaces Game Type. Ignored if a Playlist File is set

configurationFields.label: Playlist File
configurationFields.description: Optional playlist of three or more games that players vote on. Enter its file name, such as playlist1, after uploading it to the playlists folder. Overrides Map and Game Type

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can use voice chat

configurationFields.label: Global Voice
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can talk to everyone (V). Needs Voice Chat on and Project Reclaimer 0.9.15 or newer

configurationFields.label: Team Voice
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can talk to teammates (B). Needs Voice Chat on and Project Reclaimer 0.9.15 or newer

configurationFields.label: Proximity Voice
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can talk to nearby players (N). Needs Voice Chat on and Project Reclaimer 0.9.15 or newer

configurationFields.label: Text Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can use text chat

configurationFields.label: Player Votes
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players may vote to kick a player, end the round or end the game

configurationFields.label: Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If disabled, players cannot hurt teammates or campaign co-op partners. Needs Project Reclaimer 0.9.14 or newer

configurationFields.label: Team Changing
configurationFields.description: How players may change teams: Balanced (only to a smaller team), Game Type (follows the game type), or Off

configurationFields.label: Block VPNs
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players connecting through a VPN, proxy or hosting provider are refused. Players on your own network and admins are never refused

configurationFields.label: Stats Reporting
configurationFields.description: If enabled, finished games are reported to the Project Reclaimer public stats service, which keeps player ranks. Off by default

configurationFields.label: Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: Detect rejects cheat traffic and logs it without kicking. Enforce does the same and kicks the player. Off performs no checks

configurationFields.label: RCON Address
configurationFields.description: Who can connect to the remote console (RCON). 127.0.0.1 is this machine only. 0.0.0.0 allows every network and is not encrypted, so only allow your own tools through the firewall

configurationFields.label: Admin Player IDs
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated player IDs (64 hexadecimal characters each) that may kick and ban players. Players find their ID in the game client under Settings > Connectivity

configurationFields.label: Server Browser Listing
configurationFields.description: If enabled, this machine runs the discovery master that the server browser uses to list your server. Only one runs per machine

configurationFields.label: Download Halo 3 Files
configurationFields.description: On the next Update, downloads the Halo 3 multiplayer files (about 9 GB) with SteamCMD, and keeps them up to date on later Updates. Needs a Steam account that owns MCC and Halo 3

configurationFields.label: Include Campaign Files
configurationFields.description: Choose whether the update also downloads the Halo 3 campaign files (a download of about 7 GB, about 4 GB more on disk). They are needed for saved Forge maps that place campaign vehicles and AI, and for the Flood Infection and UNSC vs Covenant game types. Only used when Download Halo 3 Files is on

configurationFields.label: Download Workshop Items
configurationFields.description: Downloads the Workshop items listed below with SteamCMD on the next Update. Needs a Steam account that owns MCC and the Halo 3 DLC, without phone-approval Steam Guard

configurationFields.label: Workshop Item IDs
configurationFields.description: Workshop item IDs separated by commas (the number after id= in the item's address). The update log lists each map's name to use in Custom Map Name

deploymentSteps.name: Server Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$b='{SERVER_DIR}/'; $f=Get-ChildItem -Path $b -Filter 'project-reclaimer-dedicated-v*.exe' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $f){ Write-Host 'No downloaded server executable found'; exit 1 }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $b 'project-reclaimer-dedicated.exe') -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path $b -Filter 'project-reclaimer-dedicated-v*.exe' | Remove-Item -Force; Write-Host ('Installed ' + $f.Name)"

deploymentSteps.name: Halo 3 Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$b='{SERVER_DIR}/'; $g=Join-Path $b 'game\halo3'; foreach($p in @(@('hopper_map_variants','content\Maps'),@('hopper_game_variants','content\Game Modes'))){ $s=Join-Path $g $p[0]; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $s){ $d=Join-Path $b $p[1]; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $s '*') -Destination $d -Force } }; foreach($x in 'fmod','waves','hopper_game_variants','hopper_map_variants'){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath (Join-Path $g $x) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Halo 3 files installed'"

deploymentSteps.name: Workshop Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='{SERVER_DIR}/'; $base='{SERVER_DIR}/'; $ids=@('{WORKSHOPITEMS}'.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[0-9]{5,12}$' } | Select-Object -Unique); if($ids.Count -eq 0){ Write-Host 'No valid Workshop item IDs were entered. Enter the numbers after id= in each item address, separated by commas'; exit 0 }; if($ids.Count -gt 64){ Write-Host 'At most 64 Workshop items can be installed'; exit 1 }; $mods=Join-Path $base 'content\Mods'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $mods | Out-Null; $todo=@($ids | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $mods ($_+'\ModInfo.json'))) }); if($todo.Count -eq 0){ Write-Host 'All Workshop items are already installed. Delete an item folder from content/Mods to download it again'; exit 0 }; $sc=Join-Path $root 'steamcmd.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sc)){ Write-Host 'steamcmd.exe was not found'; exit 1 }; $cfg=Join-Path $root 'config\config.vdf'; $txt=''; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $cfg){ $txt=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $cfg }; $names=@([regex]::Matches($txt,'\"([^\"]+)\"\s*\{\s*\"SteamID\"') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }); $nocache='No cached Steam login was found. Run the update again and enter the Steam Guard code from the Steam Mobile app in the login prompt, instead of approving the login on the phone'; if(($names.Count -eq 0) -or ($txt -notmatch '\"ConnectCache\"')){ Write-Host $nocache; exit 1 }; $empty=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'h3_empty_stdin.txt'; Set-Content -LiteralPath $empty -Value ''; $acct=''; if($names.Count -eq 1){ $acct=$names[0] } else { foreach($n in $names){;   $probe=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'h3_probe_out.txt';   $pp=Start-Process -FilePath $sc -ArgumentList @('+login',$n,'+quit') -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardInput $empty -RedirectStandardOutput $probe;   if(-not $pp.WaitForExit(180000)){ try{ $pp.Kill() }catch{} };   if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $probe) -and ((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $probe) -match \"Logging in user '[^']*'[^\r\n]*\.\.\.OK\")){ $acct=$n; break }; } }; if(-not $acct){ Write-Host $nocache; exit 1 }; $tmp=Join-Path $base 'data\workshop-tmp'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath $tmp }; $sa=@('+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType','windows','+force_install_dir',$tmp,'+login',$acct); foreach($i in $todo){ $sa+=@('+workshop_download_item','976730',$i) }; $sa+='+quit'; $p=Start-Process -FilePath $sc -ArgumentList $sa -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardInput $empty; $t0=Get-Date; while(-not $p.HasExited){;   if(((Get-Date)-$t0).TotalSeconds -gt 7200){ try{ $p.Kill() }catch{}; Write-Host 'The Workshop download took too long and was stopped'; exit 1 };   Start-Sleep -Seconds 10;   $sz=0;   if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp){ $sz=[double](Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum };   Write-Host ('Downloading Workshop items: '+[Math]::Round($sz/1MB)+' MB'); }; $failed=0; foreach($i in $todo){;   $src=Join-Path $tmp ('steamapps\workshop\content\976730\'+$i);   if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $src 'ModInfo.json'))){ Write-Host ('Workshop item '+$i+' did not download. Check that the Steam account owns Halo: The Master Chief Collection and the Halo 3 DLC'); $failed++; continue };   robocopy $src (Join-Path $mods $i) /E /MOVE /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8){ Write-Host ('Copying Workshop item '+$i+' failed'); $failed++; continue };   $maps=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $mods ($i+'\maps')) -Filter *.map -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.BaseName });   Write-Host ('Workshop item '+$i+' installed. Maps: '+($maps -join ', ')); }; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if($failed -gt 0){ exit 1 }; Write-Host 'Workshop items installed'; exit 0"

deploymentSteps.name: Initialise Wine
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "export WINEPREFIX=\"{SERVER_DIR}/.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES=\"mscoree,mshtml=\"; if [ ! -f \"$WINEPREFIX/system.reg\" ]; then /usr/bin/xvfb-run -a /bin/bash -c 'K=$(printf \"HKCU\134Software\134Wine\134Drivers\"); /usr/bin/wineboot --init && /usr/bin/wine reg add \"$K\" /v Audio /t REG_SZ /f >/dev/null && /usr/bin/wineserver --wait' && echo 'Wine prefix created'; else echo \"Wine prefix already exists. Skipping\"; fi"

deploymentSteps.name: Generate Server Configuration
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$b='{SERVER_DIR}/'; foreach($d in 'game','content\Maps','content\Game Modes','content\Mods','playlists','data'){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $b $d) | Out-Null }; $u=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false); $bans=Join-Path $b 'bans.json'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bans)){ [IO.File]::WriteAllText($bans,'{ \"players\": [], \"ips\": [] }',$u) }; function Q($s){ $q=[string][char]34; $bs=[string][char]92; $q + $s.Replace($bs,$bs+$bs).Replace($q,$bs+$q) + $q }; $admins=(('{ADMINS}'.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$' } | ForEach-Object { Q $_ }) -join ', '); $mp='{MAPNAME}'; $cm='{CUSTOMMAPNAME}'.Trim(); if(('{USECUSTOMMAP}' -eq 'true') -and $cm){ $mp=$cm }; $gt='{CUSTOMGAMETYPE}'.Trim(); if(-not $gt){ $gt='{GAMETYPE}' }; $pl='{PLAYLISTFILE}'.Trim(); $pl=$pl.Replace([string][char]92,'/'); $pl=$pl.TrimStart('/'); if($pl){ if(-not $pl.Contains('/')){ $pl='playlists/'+$pl }; if(-not $pl.ToLower().EndsWith('.json')){ $pl=$pl+'.playlist.json' } }; if($pl){ $pick=@('playlist = ' + (Q $pl)) } else { $pick=@(('map = ' + (Q $mp)), ('game = ' + (Q $gt))) }; $wm='{WELCOMEMESSAGE}'.Trim(); $wl=@(); if($wm){ $wl=@('welcome = ' + (Q $wm)) }; $st='\"off\"'; if('{STATSREPORTING}' -eq 'true'){ $st='\"\"' }; $t=@('game = \"game\"','content = \"content\"','data = \"data\"','bans = \"bans.json\"',('public_address = ' + (Q '{PUBLICADDRESS}')),'upnp = false','auto_update = false',('admins = [' + $admins + ']'),('stats_server = ' + $st),'','[master]','enabled = {MASTERENABLED}','port = {SERVER_BROWSER_PORT}','','[rcon]',('password = ' + (Q '{RCON_PASSWORD}')),('address = ' + (Q '{RCONADDRESS}')),'','[defaults]','voice = {VOICECHAT}','voice_global = {VOICEGLOBAL}','voice_team = {VOICETEAM}','voice_proximity = {VOICEPROXIMITY}','text_chat = {TEXTCHAT}','chat_log = true','votes = {VOTES}','friendly_fire = {FRIENDLYFIRE}','team_changing = \"{TEAMCHANGING}\"','block_vpn = {BLOCKVPN}',('password = ' + (Q '{JOINPASSWORD}')),'max_players = {SLOTS}','anti_cheat = \"{ANTICHEAT}\"','','[[server]]',('name = ' + (Q '{SERVER_NAME}')),'port = {GAME_PORT}','hidden = {HIDDEN}') + $pick + $wl; [IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Join-Path $b 'dedicated.toml'),[string[]]$t,$u); Write-Host 'dedicated.toml written'"

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
